_README: Single source of truth for business identity. Values set to null are not yet supplied by the licence holder. Nothing on the public site ever prints the word PLACEHOLDER: a null field is simply omitted from the page and from the structured data. src/config.js lists the outstanding nulls at boot and blocks a production start until the required ones are filled.
tagline: Factory and custom Glock pistols, slides and triggers, transferred through a licensed dealer in Texas
fflLicenceType: Type 01, Dealer in Firearms Other Than Destructive Devices

jurisdiction.regulator: Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives
jurisdiction.backgroundCheckSystem: FBI National Instant Criminal Background Check System (NICS)
jurisdiction.notes: Confirmed for a licensed dealer operating in Texas. Federal law sets the age floor at 21 for a handgun bought from a licensed dealer and 18 for a rifle or shotgun. Texas adds no purchase permit, no waiting period and no state registration. These values must be re-checked if the law changes or if the business begins trading in another state.

policy.transferProcessText: We ship to your dropoff location. For firearms, your dropoff location must be a Federal Firearms Licensee, and the buyer completes the transfer in person at that licensee's premises. At the counter the buyer presents a valid government issued photo ID showing their current residential address, completes ATF Form 4473, and the licensee runs a background check through the FBI National Instant Criminal Background Check System. The firearm is released only on a proceed result. Texas imposes no state waiting period, no purchase permit and no state registration, so a proceed result normally means the transfer completes the same day. Federal law limits handgun sales by a licensed dealer to residents of that dealer's state, so a handgun bought by an out of state customer is shipped to a licensee in the customer's own state and transferred there.
policy.transferFeeNote: The receiving licensee sets their own transfer fee. It is paid by the buyer directly to that licensee and is not included in the price shown on this site.
